maria: FYI—noticed a $43k deferral variance on March close tied to prepaid commits. invoice IDs: INV-98123, INV-98124
kevin: Is this from the Acme pilot usage split? :thinking_face:
maria: Looks like ACME had a mid-month amendment; billing ledger shows credit applied but rev schedule didn't adjust
josh: Can you paste the SQL that pulls unbilled usage? I can run to reconcile
maria: ```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(usage_tokens) as tokens, invoice_id
FROM billing.usage
WHERE period_start >= '2025-03-01' AND period_end <= '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY 1,3;
```
kevin: ran it—ACME had 1.2M extra tokens split across two invoices. I'll DM the CSV
billingbot: auto-note: invoice INV-98123 adjusted by credit 2025-04-02 10:12Z
lisa: we need a JE for the deferral correction. @finance-ops can you approve? recommended entry: Debit Deferred Revenue $43,000 / Credit Revenue $43,000
maria: tagging @cpa-approvals — can we get this in March cut? it's a material recon
cpa-approvals: Approved. Please attach the supporting CSV and updated rev schedule id RS-2025-03-17
kevin: I'll upload CSV and create RS-2025-03-17. Leaving a note in the close tracker
maria: thanks — closing loop. will follow up with a short memo for auditors.
